svg.title: The central package around the scheduler
svg.desc: Component diagram: the dispatcher sits between the job sources, the garage tracker, the scheduler and the machines; the other central nodes monitor or report.

g.text: The scheduler talks to one node only: the dispatcher calls /scheduler/plan and nothing else calls it. Everything the scheduler knows about the garage arrives in that request.
